summary: Well-structured test suite with three layers (workflow structure, unit, integration via act). Covers all core functionality: glob patterns (*, **, ?), multiple labels, priority ordering, deduplication, error handling, both output formats, stdin input, and all 5 fixtures through a single efficient act run. Tests assert exact expected values via result_for() helper and verify all jobs succeeded. Gaps: (1) No explicit test that script passes shellcheck/bash -n validation (required by task), (2) Minor edge cases untested (special chars in filenames, unicode, case sensitivity, default priority=0), (3) yq() YAML helper is custom-coded Python invocation—less robust than using a dedicated tool. The workflow_act.bats setup_file strategy is elegant: one `act push` run covers all matrix cases, results saved to act-result.txt artifact as required. Test isolation and independence are solid; helper functions (write_rules, write_files) keep cases clean.
